title: Subterranean Escape Pod
description: You are trapped in an n x n subterranean grid cave system. Each cell in the grid has a varying elevation hazard level represented by grid[r][c]. You start at the top-left cell (0, 0) and want to reach the bottom-right cell (n - 1, n - 1). At any time unit t, the water level rises to t, meaning you can only traverse through cells whose hazard level is less than or equal to t. Find the minimum time t at which you can successfully path from the top-left to the bottom-right corner.
constraints: Each value in the grid is a unique integer from 0 to n^2 - 1
input_format: A 2D integer array grid representing elevation hazards.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum time required to reach the destination.

examples.explanation: At time 3, all cells are accessible, and a valid path exists from (0,0) to (1,1).
The optimal path utilizes cells up to hazard level 16.
Path requires enduring up to hazard 2.
